title: Theme conformance: run the spec against a preview Space in CI, and wire the type voice into role blocks
detail: LIVE-2032 built test/e2e/theme-conformance.spec.ts against a static render. Two things remain. (1) Run it in CI against a published Space whose theme is Services (CONFORMANCE_URL) and add the four checks a static render cannot give: motion-additive, empty-states, hidden-functions, surface-parity. (2) The spec found that data-type changes no role-block title face in the Services render (role blocks use --f-display, not .sv-display), so the three type voices have nothing to test there; the role skin needs to follow the voice.
